description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5999015152612 SHIELDING GASKET,EL: Line 0001 Qty 84 UI FT Deliver To: By: 0086 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
